# Supply risk stays elevated, prices climbing fast  
**Bottom line:** Expect tight supply and rising costs; lock in pricing only on parts flagged as “Lock pricing”.

## What changed
- Market supply risk holds at 73 (Neutral change) while price trend nudges up to 87.9, confirming a “Rising fast” environment[1].  
- Processor & advanced‑logic segment supply risk dips 0.1 point to 71.9, but price trend stays high at 84.8[2].  
- Analog & power‑management segment supply risk unchanged at 69.3, price trend 82.4, both driven by a 32.6 % annualized semiconductor PPI rise[3].  
- Korea’s chip‑led export surge (+100 % YoY early Nov) adds pressure on supply and price across segments[4].  
- No new alerts were issued this week.

## Featured part: IPB017N10N5ATMA1
- Lead time 14 weeks, channel stock 27,081 units (≈17.6 weeks of supply).  
- Price $5.56 / unit (qty 1) vs $2.51 / unit (qty 1k).  
- Origin Austria, tariff 0 % (no surcharge).  
- Supply risk 53.5 (Neutral) and price trend 71.9 (Rising).  
- Buy‑timing call: **Lock pricing (no need to buy ahead)** – 63 % chance prices rise in 3 months, but supply is adequate; fix price now, keep normal order cadence.


## Segment board
- Processors & advanced logic – Elevated (71.9, –0.1), Rising (84.8), High confidence.  
- Memory (DRAM/NAND/HBM) – Elevated (70.1, 0), Rising (76.9), High confidence.  
- Analog & power management – Rising (69.3, 0), Rising (82.4), High confidence.  
- Microcontrollers & embedded – Rising (68.1, 0), Rising (82.0), High confidence.  
- Power discretes (MOSFET/IGBT/SiC/GaN) – Rising (67.2, 0), Rising fast (85.5), High confidence.

## Your BOM watchlist
- **SN65HVD230DR** – supply risk 82.5, driven by 26‑week factory lead time.  
- **LM358DR** – supply risk 82.2, same 26‑week lead time pressure.  
- **TPS62130RGTR** – supply risk 81.9, 26‑week lead time despite modest price gap.  
- **TLV9002IDR** – supply risk 81.8, 26‑week lead time.  
- **ADS1115IDGSR** – supply risk 81.6, 26‑week lead time.

## Outlook
- Chip prices have a 70 % probability of rising in the next 3 months (expected +2.53 %); 80 % confidence interval –9.2 % to +14.3 % (model‑tested edge).  
- Over 6 months, price‑rise probability drops to 56 % (expected +5.07 %); 80 % range –10.2 % to +20.3 % (trend‑following baseline).  
- Fab utilization is likely to tighten (62 % chance) in 3 months (+1.82 pts, baseline).  
- In 6 months, utilization tightening probability is 60 % (+3.64 pts, baseline).  

## Negotiation angle
1. **Lock pricing now** on parts listed under “Lock pricing” (e.g., IPB017N10N5ATMA1, ATMEGA328P‑AU) to avoid the 63 % upside price risk while supply remains adequate.  
2. **Push for volume discounts** on high‑risk analog items (SN65HVD230DR, LM358DR) by highlighting 26‑week lead times and the risk of further escalation.  
3. **Ask suppliers for updated lead‑time forecasts** and any capacity commitments for the next quarter to gauge whether the 62 % fab‑utilization tightening signal will affect your critical SKUs.
